scope: Read-only independent statistical and method review; no partial primary rate data inspected; no source, protocol, Git or prior review-inventory mutation.
conclusion: No mathematical normalization/sign/bead/channel/unit or covariance blocker identified. Conditional extension authorization remains an external registered-procedure requirement, acknowledged by the study owner.

paired_comparisons.central_rate_estimator: geometric mean of independent-chain rate estimates

registered_trigger_rules.horizon: extend every registered child to 400 fs if 200-fs time plateau gate fails; no selective extension

Reevaluate gates on all four pairs; no extension based on closeness to a paper point.

Point-agreement/precision gates differ from the separately reported full-CI-inside-paper-band diagnostic.
1-fs pair observations cannot exclude between-frame domain crossings; energy screen is not a rate-bias bound.
